skill.name: community-marketing
skill.description: Create community strategies, launch plans, engagement systems, ambassador programs, and health audits for online communities.
skill.summary: Plan, launch, grow, and audit communities that support engagement, advocacy, retention, and community-led growth.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

security_audit.summary: Static findings are false positives from Markdown code formatting and non-security community strategy text in SKILL.md. I found no evidence of command execution, network reconnaissance, data exfiltration, or prompt injection behavior.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 15 uses Markdown inline code to name optional local context files. It asks the assistant to read context if present, not execute shell backticks or build a command.
Lines 56-60 are a fenced Markdown diagram showing a community flywheel. The backticks open and close a code block and do not contain executable commands.
Lines 46-47 describe member benefits such as exclusive knowledge and peer connections. They do not instruct network scanning, discovery, or reconnaissance.

content.value_statement: Communities often stall because members lack a clear reason to participate. This skill turns product context into launch plans, rituals, audits, and advocate programs.
actual_capabilities: Checks for existing product marketing context before asking for missing details.
Defines member identity, value proposition, goals, and community stage assumptions.
Compares Discord, Slack, Circle, Reddit, Facebook Groups, and Discourse.
Creates launch plans, channel architecture, welcome journeys, ritual calendars, and ambassador briefs.
Audits health metrics such as DAU/MAU, new member post rate, reply rate, and lurker ratio.
limitations: Does not connect to Discord, Slack, or forum APIs.
Cannot verify live community metrics unless the user provides them.
Provides strategy and templates, not moderation enforcement or legal policy review.
Needs product, audience, and goal context for precise recommendations.

use_cases.title: Launch a Community From Zero
use_cases.description: Create a platform choice, founding member plan, core loop, and first 90 days of activity.

use_cases.title: Revive Low Member Engagement
use_cases.description: Diagnose lurker behavior, redesign onboarding, add recurring rituals, and invest in power users.

use_cases.title: Reduce Support Load With Peer Help
use_cases.description: Turn repeated questions into knowledge base topics and recognize members who help others.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Community Platform
prompt_templates.prompt: We are building a community for [audience]. Compare Discord, Slack, Circle, Reddit, and Discourse. Recommend one platform and explain the tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Plan the First 90 Days
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 90-day launch plan for a [product] community. Include founding member outreach, onboarding, channels, rituals, and weekly success metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Ambassador Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an ambassador program for a community with [member count] members. Include candidate criteria, benefits, outreach, enablement assets, and measurement.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Community Health
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit our community health using these metrics: [metrics]. Diagnose the main dropoff point and give the top three priorities for the next month.

output_examples.input: We are a B2B SaaS team choosing between Discord and Slack.
output: Recommendation: Start with Slack if your buyers work there daily.
Tradeoff: Slack feels professional, but free history limits can hurt learning.
Next step: Validate the choice with five ideal members before launch.

output_examples.input: We have 40 members, but only three post each week.
output: Diagnosis: This is a new member activation problem.
Priority 1: Welcome each member by name and ask one specific question.
Priority 2: Seed five example posts that model useful participation.

output_examples.input: Our support community should reduce repeated tickets.
output: Plan: Convert top questions into searchable knowledge base topics.
Recognition: Give helpful members visible expert status and public thanks.
Guardrail: Keep company response times below 24 hours for open questions.

best_practices: Share product, audience, platform, stage, and business goal before asking for a plan.
Use member identity and value exchange as the basis for every recommendation.
Track community health weekly and compare changes after each onboarding change.
anti_patterns: Opening a public community before founding members create baseline activity.
Treating peer support as a way to avoid company responsibility.
Launching generic channels and events without a clear member behavior loop.

faq.question: What platforms does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It compares Discord, Slack, Circle, Reddit, Facebook Groups, and Discourse for different community types.

faq.question: Can it create a full launch plan?
faq.answer: Yes. It can produce a 90-day plan with outreach, onboarding, channels, rituals, and metrics.

faq.question: Does it manage my community directly?
faq.answer: No. It provides strategy, templates, and audits. It does not operate platform accounts or moderate conversations.

faq.question: Can it help with ambassador programs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can define selection criteria, benefits, outreach, enablement assets, and tracking.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide your product, audience, platform, community stage, business goal, and available member metrics.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
